result.summary: Found 2 layout/content issues: truncated restaurant name in the Fastest near you carousel and incomplete category chip row styling at the right edge.

issues.description: The third restaurant card title is truncated mid-word as 'Trattoria Piccol' instead of showing the full name, and the delivery fee line may also be affected by insufficient card/text width.
issues.suggestion: Allow multi-line titles, reduce font size on long names, or ensure card width and text wrapping/ellipsis so the full restaurant name remains readable.

issues.description: The category filter chips row ends with a faint partial chip on the far right with no label, which looks like a broken or unfinished UI element rather than a clean carousel fade.
issues.suggestion: Hide incomplete chip outlines, use a proper edge fade/mask, or ensure only fully rendered chips (or a clear scroll affordance) appear at the edge.
